summary: Glass House Brands filed a Form 6-K on September 29, 2026, accompanying a press release announcing the planned retirement of CFO Mark Vendetti, effective March 31, 2027. Vendetti will remain in the role through that date while the company searches for a successor. CEO Kyle Kazan praised Vendetti's five-year tenure. No financial terms, stake changes, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock were disclosed. This is a routine, planned succession rather than a forced or abrupt departure, so it does not qualify as a special situation. Watch for successor appointment and any strategic shifts under new financial leadership.
